title: Crumple
description: The Beatles' Shea Stadium setlist, or a halftone Abbey Road poster, drawn like a comic panel. Press and hold to scrunch it into a ball and drag it around; the paper animates on twos at 12 frames a second with ink outlines and screen-tone shading while your cursor stays smooth, and every crumple leaves its creases behind.
intent: One paper mechanic in a stylised frame rate: a crumple mesh drawn as held comic frames, so the scrunch reads as drawn animation instead of a simulation that looks slightly off.
